title: Sr. Data Analytics Engineer
description:
About Credix  

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job We are looking for someone to join Credix as a a Senior Analytics Engineer. You will take ownership of structuring our data analytics platform and analytics use-cases. You love to tackle big problems and break them down into smaller pieces. You will build an analytics platform that features reliable, timely and understandable metrics in a slice-and-dice format to empower other teams to make better decisions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain dbt models and reliable datasets that power analytics, experiments, and decision-making across the company.
  • Define and act upon standards for metrics, data modeling practices, and documentation.
  • Oversee the full analytics lifecycle, from transforming raw to delivering insights in BI platforms (e.g. Hex).
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure analytics pipelines meet high standards of quality, observability and testing.
  • Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
  • Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
  • Experience in a (credit) FinTech is a must.
  • Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
  • Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
  • Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
  • Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
  • High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2B credit market in Brazil by using data.
  • Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Account Manager
description:
Altenar is a leading provider of sportsbook software and services to licensed gaming operators. We deliver a complete range of solutions — from “software-only” offerings to fully managed sports betting platform stacks — ensuring stability, flexibility, and personalized service . Our software is developed and operated entirely in-house and powered by premium-quality data feeds .


Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive, passionate, and dedicated Account Manager to act as the main point of contact between our clients and internal teams. The ideal candidate will have a strong focus on client satisfaction, relationship management, and operational excellence, ensuring that each client receives outstanding support and value from our products and services.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary contact for client needs, inquiries, and concerns.
  • Build and nurture strong client relationships to foster retention and growth.
  • Oversee client accounts, ensuring services meet business goals, expectations, and budgets.
  • Collaborate with internal teams — including sales, product, and operations — to deliver tailored solutions.
  • Proactively identify and resolve issues, continuously improving client experience and internal processes.
  • Work closely with the product team to align updates and features with client expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Altenar’s offerings to identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for clients, ensuring a seamless and positive partnership.


Requirements & Skills:

  • Languages: Portuguese (proficient), English (intermediate or higher).
  • Previous experience in account management, sales, or customer service .
  • Strong multitasking and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to collect, track, and interpret data effectively.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Problem-solving attitude and adaptability in fast-paced environments.
  • Proven ability to build rapport and collaborate with diverse teams.
  • Experience in the sports betting or iGaming industry is a strong advantage.


What We Offer

  • A stable, flexible, and collaborative working environment.
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A multinational team of industry experts from around the world.


Please, submit your CV in English when applying for this vacancy.

title: IT Helpdesk Engineer, Corporate IT
description:
Corporate IT is the backbone of our business. Our team helps the company to develop a competitive advantage through defining our technology objectives, assessing solution options, and devising technical solutions that help us achieve both strategic goals and meet operational requirements. As a part of our team, you’ll help deliver seamless IT experiences and support to our internal employees by providing responsive helpdesk service, stable networks and reliable IT systems.


As a Helpdesk Engineer, you will be responsible for implementing IT operations according to policy, interpret IT related issues on both System and User side to meet corporate requirements, and provide technical support in a fast-paced and demanding environment.


Job Description:

  • Provide day-to-day technical support to end users and ensure the smooth running of computers, network devices and printers
  • Troubleshoot and resolve end user application issues, maintain and update technical support documentation
  • Handle asset management, maintain inventory and liaise with vendors
  • Maintain and monitor office network infrastructure, IT security and antivirus tools
  • Other duties include performing first level troubleshooting and support for scheduled server backups, system monitoring and reports


Job Requirements:

  • Diploma or degree in Computer Sciences, Information Technology or a related field preferred
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience operating in a similar role
  • In-depth knowledge of computer hardware, software, and OS (Windows and macOS)
  • Understanding of TCP/IP, IP addressing and LAN technology including switching and routing fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience in Windows server administration and basic knowledge in Linux server administration is a plus
  • Professional Qualification - Microsoft Certified/CCNA is a plus
  • Knowledge of basic setup and configuration of Cisco devices such as firewall, switch, IP phones, wireless controller and access points is a plus
  • Competent at documenting standard operating procedures and knowledge articles
  • Ability to cover after-office hours and weekend support if there are any infrastructure issues or activities
  • Enthusiastic and willing to learn in a fluid and fast-paced environment
  • Passionate in IT technology and wants to make a difference with technology solutions
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively at all levels
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills

title: Senior Sales Manager for Retail Media Brazil
description:
US Media is a Sales House specialized in Latin America, currently working with Tinder, vevo, WeTransfer, Sojern, Fandom and others.

We are a team that is making a massive impact and we are looking for a talented, ambitious and well-connected HUNGRY style digital ad sales professional to generate ad sales business.


Estamos buscando um Senior Sales Manager & Partner Management Retail Media para atuar na expansão de negócios no segmento de mídia, com foco em aquisição de novos clientes. Procuramos um profissional hunter, com forte capacidade de prospecção, negociação e fechamento de contratos. O candidato ideal deve ter experiência consolidada em vendas B2B, relacionamento com clientes de médio porte e profundo conhecimento do mercado de publicidade digital.  


Main Responsibilities:

✅ Prospectar e conquistar novos clientes no segmento retail media, focando em anunciantes diretos e agências.  

✅ Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de vendas para impulsionar o crescimento da receita e expandir a carteira de clientes.  

✅ Construir e manter um pipeline sólido de oportunidades, gerenciando todo o ciclo de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento de contratos.  

✅ Identificar as necessidades dos clientes e propor soluções estratégicas em mídia digital, alinhadas às suas demandas e objetivos da área.

✅ Colaborar com times internos, como marketing, operações e customer success, para garantir entregas de alto impacto para os clientes.  

✅ Analisar tendências de mercado e concorrência, identificando novas oportunidades de crescimento.  

✅ Participar de eventos do setor, conferências e reuniões estratégicas para fortalecer o posicionamento da empresa no mercado.  


Experiência e Background

  • 3 a 6 anos de experiência comercial em mídia digital, e-commerce, adtech, ou plataformas de varejo.
  • Vivência em operações de Retail Media (ou em players correlatos: Criteo, CitrusAd, Amazon Ads, Mercado Ads, Walmart Connect, etc.).

  • Entendimento sólido de estratégias de retail media on-site e off-site , DSPs e first-party data.
  • Noções de atribuição e mensuração de mídia (ROAS, incrementality, etc.).
  • Domínio das principais métricas de e-commerce (CTR, conversion rate, share of search, basket size, etc.).

  • Forte capacidade de storytelling e negociação com CMOs, heads de trade e agências .
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a resultado , com pensamento estratégico e postura consultiva.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar com modelos híbridos de negócio (branding + performance).

 Idiomas

title: Sales Operations & Data Analyst
description:

▪️Apoiar o design, a automação e a escalabilidade de processos globais de Operações de Vendas por meio de ferramentas com tecnologia de IA (por exemplo, Microsoft Power Apps, Copilot, modelos de IA/ML) e soluções baseadas em dados.

▪️Criar, manter e otimizar painéis de relatórios no Power BI, Excel e SQL para gerar insights acionáveis e permitir a tomada de decisões com base em dados.

▪️Colaborar com stakeholders multifuncionais (Operações de Vendas, Operações Centrais, Produto, Engenharia) para identificar ineficiências, simplificar fluxos de trabalho e implementar soluções escaláveis.

▪️Desenvolver e documentar processos, fluxos de dados e fluxos de trabalho do estado atual vs. estado futuro para apoiar a transformação dos negócios.

▪️Identificar oportunidades para reduzir esforços manuais por meio de automações com Python, APIs ou soluções baseadas em IA.

▪️Atuar como defensor(a) do usuário para as equipes de Operações de Vendas e Vendas, garantindo que o design dos processos melhore a eficiência, a adoção e a usabilidade.

▪️Apoiar a governança de projetos mantendo acompanhamentos (trackers), canais de comunicação e registros de riscos/problemas para garantir responsabilidade e entregas.


Qualificações Básicas

▪️Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em Operações de Vendas, Operações de Negócios, Análise de Dados ou funções similares.

▪️Proficiência em SQL, Python, Power BI e Excel para analisar dados, criar relatórios e automatizar fluxos de trabalho.

▪️Experiência com a Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Query) ou ferramentas similares de automação low-code/no-code.

▪️Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas, com capacidade comprovada de simplificar processos complexos.

▪️Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal em inglês e português.


☑️Qualificações Desejáveis

▪️Experiência na aplicação de ferramentas de IA/ML ou automação para otimizar operações, reduzir esforços manuais ou melhorar a tomada de decisão.

▪️Familiaridade com Salesforce (SFDC), Dynamics 365 (D365) ou outros sistemas CRM/ERP.

▪️Capacidade comprovada de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em um ambiente global dinâmico.

▪️Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e capacidade de colaborar com equipes multiculturais e em diferentes fusos horários.

▪️Experiência com processos de vendas como planejamento de headcount, desenho de territórios, definição de metas ou previsão de vendas (forecasting).

▪️Demonstração de curiosidade e vontade de explorar novas fronteiras de excelência operacional por meio de tecnologia e inovação.

title: After-sales Service Manager
description:

As the biggest engine manufacturer in China, Weichai Group is looking for a high-performance After-sales Service Manager for engine service and channel development. This position will be mainly responsible for the Brazil market, but also include the Guyana market, planning and implementing all directing activities of Weichai engines service activities.

This role will focus on managing the operations of the service center and ensuring customer satisfaction through effective service management and continuous improvement activities.



Responsibilities



  • Manages all operations of service center including service staff and supervisors;
  • Resolves most complex business problems for those on the team;
  • Leads continuous improvement activities by reviewing, changing, and improving processes in line with changing customer expectations goals;
  • Responsible for the construction and optimization of local services and accessories network;

title: Government Relations Director, Brazil
description:
SHEIN

Founded in 2012, SHEIN is a leading global online retailer, with operations in Guangzhou,

Singapore, Los Angeles, and other key markets around the world. SHEIN reaches consumers


in more than 150 locations globally, enabling them to access more fashion, beauty and

lifestyle products easily and conveniently, at affordable prices. Our mission is to help

everyone - regardless of their location, body size, ethnicity, income level - express their

individuality through access to the latest trends.


SHEIN works with outstanding, creative and highly capable peers. Our culture is energetic,

collaborative and open to new ideas and suggestions, enabling outstanding individuals to

come together and ignite new possibilities as a team. SHEIN welcomes passionate and

enthusiastic individuals to join us in driving SHEIN’s growth and expansion globally, making

it possible for everyone to wear and live their most wonderful lives.


Summary of Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the analysis and providing

assessment of relevant public policy issues and their implications on SHEIN’s business

interests in Brazil. He/she is responsible for fostering strategic partnerships with key

stakeholders and translating policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to

advance SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil. He/she will also plan,

organise and manage SHEIN’s various stakeholder engagement platforms in Brazil, in

support of the objective to expand and enhance our collaborations with key stakeholders from various backgrounds such as political/regulatory stakeholders, civil society, industry

associations and other public arenas.


In this role, the candidate must be able to work effectively with various teams, including the Customer Service, Sustainability, Legal, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams, to advance

SHEIN’s corporate interests in Brazil. He/she should possess a deep interest and ability to

understand how politics, business, fashion, sustainability, technology and innovation, as well as international relations are interconnected.


Job Responsibilities

  • Track, monitor and assess strategic/policy issues and their implications to SHEIN’s commercial interests in Brazil.
  • Develop and provide recommendations to SHEIN’s senior management and relevant business units concerning political, policy, and regulatory issues.
  • Identify, engage and build relations with key stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, non-governmental organizations, media, and industry associations) to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil.
  • Identify and map key policy stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, international organisations, non-governmental organisations and industry associations).
  • Develop and drive engagement strategies to reach out and build strategic relationships with key stakeholders to strengthen SHEIN’s network of partners.
  • Formulate and execute advocacy plans to translate policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts.
  • Develop and drive strategic communications plans and partnerships in support of company’s overall policy positioning and profiling.
  • Organise and manage meetings with external parties, including the preparation of briefing notes/presentations for senior management’s reference.
  • Lead in the planning, organisation and management of networking platforms


Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Degree in International Relations, Political Science, Global Studies, Law, Economics, Communications, Media, Journalism, or related fields.
  • At least 10 years of working experience in corporate/public affairs, and/or government relations/public policy, and/or corporate communications/public relations.
  • Experience in policy research, development, and analysis, and/or track record in developing and implementing external communication strategies/campaigns
  • Strong policy/regulatory network and/or media relations in Brazil.
  • Strong analytical, presentation (written and oral), and project management skills.
  • Good knowledge and experience in digital media tools/platforms
  • Strong proficiency in English and Portuguese; Spanish preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and have exceptional attention to detail while operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.



Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.



Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.



Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)



Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

title: Analista de Precificação Sênior
description:
Somos a Copa Energia, uma empresa brasileira, referência em soluções energéticas e à frente das próximas inovações do setor para construir um amanhã melhor a partir de uma matriz energética mais limpa.


Através das nossas duas marcas, Copagaz e Liquigás, respondemos por 25% da distribuição de Gás Liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP) do Brasil. Possuímos operações em 25 estados e Distrito Federal e cerca de 90 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos. Sendo a maior empresa no segmento de GLP da América Latina.   • Realizar análises detalhadas de rentabilidade por produto, segmento e região;

  • Apoiar a gestão no controle de indicadores e gestão de resultados da área, consolidar e avaliar os resultados mensais, visando a definição de novas estratégias;
  • Elaborar indicadores para acompanhamento de performance e melhoria contínua;
  • Explicar os preços realizados para salvaguardar os resultados planejados pela empresa no budget e forecast, identificando riscos e oportunidades para ajustes proativos na política de preços da empresa;
  • Atuar em processos de alta complexidade, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e fazendo sugestões de mudanças;
  • Realizar análises complexas e detalhadas de dados, problemas ou processos através de modelagem estatística, análise de tendências, previsões e recomendações estratégicas baseadas em dados;
  • Realizar estudos de mudança de Política de Preços, incentivos comerciais e promoções. Contribuir significativamente para a tomada de decisões estratégicas, baseadas em análises críticas e interpretação de dados;
  • Propor alterações de preços diante de mudanças de cenários macro-econômicos, concorrências e estratégicos da empresa;
  • Preparar e conduzir parcialmente Comitê de Preços com as informações do seu segmento;
  • Facilitar a comunicação com as áreas parceiras construindo e propondo oportunidade de melhorias processuais. Gerenciar projetos analíticos, desde a concepção até a implementação e avaliação dos resultados, assegurando que os prazos e objetivos sejam alcançados;

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade, Estatística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação em Marketing, Gestão Atuarial e Financeira e correlatos;

title: IT Operations Manager
description:
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.Our Core Focuses:End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the comprehensive operation and maintenance management of IT infrastructure (including but not limited to servers, networks, storage, and related software platforms) within large-scale operational environments in the Americas region.

2. Develop and implement IT operation strategies, procedures, and standards (SOPs) to ensure the efficient, stable, and secure operation of IT systems, in compliance with internal and external regulations.

3. Manage the IT operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, team development, and daily management, to enhance team professionalism and efficiency.

4. Lead IT incident management, event response, change management, and problem-solving processes to ensure high availability and business continuity of IT systems.

5. Drive the IT operations' transformation towards automation and intelligence, introducing advanced technologies and tools to continuously optimize operational processes, efficiency, and quality.

6. Responsible for IT infrastructure capacity planning, performance monitoring, and optimization to ensure resource allocation meets business growth demands.

7. Manage IT-related vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring their service quality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

8. Responsible for IT operations budget planning, cost control, and analysis of technology investment returns.

9. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., Facilities, Asset Management, Security, Business Units) to ensure IT operations effectively support overall business objectives.

10. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, supporting the evolution of IT architecture to enhance technological competitiveness.



Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, or a related IT professional field.

2. Over 5 years of experience in large-scale IT system operation and maintenance management, with at least 3 years in a team management role; experience in multinational corporations is a plus.

3. In-depth understanding and practical experience with server hardware, operating systems (Linux/Windows), network technologies (TCP/IP, routing & switching), and storage systems.

4. Familiar with ITIL/ITSM management frameworks, possessing excellent capabilities in ITIL process implementation and optimization.

5. Practical experience with IT automation and intelligent operation tools (e.g., scripting languages, monitoring systems, configuration management tools).

6. Excellent team leadership, project management, and risk management capabilities.

7. Outstanding communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, capable of handling complex technical and managerial issues.

8. Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

9. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CCIE/CCNP, RHCE are a plus.

10. (Plus) Experience in cloud platform operations or DevOps practices is a plus.

title: Risk Analyst
description:
About Credix  

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job 

In SME credit, advantage compounds through disciplined underwriting, fast learning cycles, and early detection of risks. As our Credit Analyst, you will strengthen our underwriting edge by translating financial data, behavioural signals, and real-world borrower performance into precise credit decisions- while continuously feeding insights back into our core decision models.


Responsibilities

  • Conduct holistic credit analysis for SMEs: financials, cash-flows, tax compliance, bank data, concentration risks, behavioural signals.
  • Produce concise, decision-ready credit memos with recommendations (approve / adjust / decline).
  • Lead periodic reviews of high-exposure borrowers - liquidity evolution, leverage shifts, payment patterns, and macro impacts.
  • Evaluate and recommend credit-limit increases based on performance, updated financials, and risk appetite.
  • Maintain a closed-loop feedback mechanism between underwriting decisions and portfolio outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Data to translate recurring insights into better thresholds, features, and model logic.
  • Support portfolio monitoring with early-warning detection and risk-mitigation recommendations.
  • Ensure underwriting discipline and audit-ready documentation.


Qualifications

  • 2–3 years in IB, credit, structured credit, asset management, DCM or fintech underwriting.
  • Strong financial analysis: liquidity, leverage, coverage, working-capital dynamics, seasonality.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian tax reporting, accounting regimes, and corporate structures.
  • Experience writing clear, investor-grade credit memos.
  • Understanding of credit models (inputs, outputs, sensitivity) and ability to evaluate their strengths/weaknesses.
  • Bonus: exposure to securitisation, structured credit, data-driven underwriting.
  • High analytical rigor and precision in judgment.
  • “Manager of one”- delivers independently with consistency.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, both in English and Portuguese.
  • Proactive in identifying trends, risks, and model improvement opportunities.
  • Thrives in a high-velocity, high-accountability environment.
  • Passion for modernising Brazil’s B2B credit market through technology and transparency.
  • Integrity, long-term thinking, and intellectual honesty.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Itaim Bibi, Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package 
  • Paid Time Off 
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

title: Collections Specialist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

As Collections Specialist, you will own the strategy that protects liquidity and strengthens trust in the Credix ecosystem. Operations runs the day-to-day recoveries; your role is to define the strategy, policy, and data intelligence that make those efforts precise, fair, and scalable. You’ll guide how we balance recovery and relationships, when to engage, when to escalate, and when to step back.

You’ll refine our existing policy and performance frameworks, turning data into foresight and our network data into leverage - ensuring that Credix’s collections model becomes a competitive advantage, not just a control function.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience in credit recovery in the context of Brazilian SMEs.
  • Proficiency with SQL and BI tools.
  • Ability to interpret cohort data and design actionable segmentation strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazil’s legal and judicial collection frameworks.
  • Clear communicator; able to translate data into field-ready direction.
  • Collaborative but decisive - able to guide Operations while respecting ownership.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a bias toward execution.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.


Responsibilities

  • Own the collections strategy and policy across all product lines.
  • Guide Operations: ensure day-to-day execution follows data-backed policy and economic logic.
  • Oversee complex recoveries and litigation, directly managing negotiations on high-value or reputationally sensitive cases.
  • Partner with the Data team to evolve our analytics layer - feeding insights from collections into credit models and underwriting.
  • Optimise the economic model of recovery: continuously measure ROI per effort type and segment.
  • Manage external partners (law firms, collection agencies) with a clear view of cost, compliance, and outcome quality.
  • Report and communicate results clearly to leadership and investors - recovery performance, portfolio health, and systemic learnings.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: PMO Especialista - Desenvolvimento de Negócios
description:
A Química Anastacio é uma das maiores distribuidoras de produtos químicos da América Latina e oferece um amplo portfólio de produtos e ingredientes, além de soluções e serviços inteligentes, auxiliando os clientes e fornecedores no crescimento dos seus negócios. Contamos com uma excelente estrutura comercial, logística e técnica, e atendemos todas as indústrias do mercado.


Nos últimos anos, fortalecemos nossas operações transformando em ágil, simples e focada no cliente. Hoje temos 6 centros de distribuições localizados estrategicamente no Brasil, presença na Argentina e México, com meta de expandir nossa participação no mercado da América Latina e representamos cerca de 400 fornecedores globais.


Para mais informações, visite

  • Gerenciar o portfólio de projetos de desenvolvimento de negócios: novos produtos, fornecedores, segmentos e parcerias estratégicas.
  • Avaliar e implantar softwares e métodos de gestão de projetos, assegurando documentação estruturada e padronização de processos.
  • Promover reuniões de acompanhamento (diárias, semanais e mensais) com as equipes envolvidas, garantindo alinhamento e ritmo nas entregas.
  • Implantar e aprimorar ferramentas de gestão de projetos e governanças corporativas que garantam análises de viabilidade técnicas e financeiras de forma ágil e padronizada.
  • Estruturar e treinar os stakeholders em metodologias de projeto, governança e ferramentas de acompanhamento.
  • Liderar o calendário de business reports , consolidando resultados, impacto financeiro, desvios críticos e aprendizados.
  • Definir e aplicar critérios de priorização de projetos , criando uma matriz de decisão estratégica e coordenando fóruns de go/no go.
  • Construir e monitorar o pipeline de projetos , com SLAs e indicadores de eficiência (tempo, esforço, retorno, margem).
  • Mapear recursos necessários (financeiros, humanos e técnicos) e propor otimizações de alocação.
  • Estruturar o pool de oportunidades da companhia, centralizando ideias, mensurando impactos e apoiando a tomada de decisão executiva.

Formação:

  • Graduação completa (Administração, Engenharia, Química ou áreas correlatas);
  • Pós-graduação ou certificações (PMP, Scrum Master, Lean, PM², etc.) são diferenciais.
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de portfólio de projetos , preferencialmente em empresas B2B industriais, químicas ou de distribuição.

title: Assistente de vendas
description:
Tarefas Auxiliar de Vendas

As tarefas de um auxiliar de vendas geralmente envolvem apoiar a equipe comercial e garantir que o processo de vendas seja mais ágil e organizado. Aqui estão as principais responsabilidades:

  • Atualizar planilhas e sistemas de CRM (cadastro de clientes, propostas, follow-ups).
  • Organizar documentos de vendas, contratos e orçamentos.
  • Preparar relatórios de desempenho (metas, resultados, pipeline).
  • Acompanhar envios considerando fretes e coleta por parte da transportadora.

 Apoio Comercial

  • Auxiliar na elaboração de propostas comerciais.
  • Realizar cotações com fornecedores e validação de estoques.
  • Dar suporte ao time de vendas em apresentações ou reuniões.
  • Acompanhar status de negociações e prazos de entrega.

Atendimento ao Cliente

  • Atender clientes por telefone, e-mail ou WhatsApp.
  • Esclarecer dúvidas sobre produtos, preços e prazos.
  • Encaminhar contatos para os vendedores responsáveis.
  • Fazer follow-up (acompanhamento) de propostas enviadas.

Organização e Logística

  • Controlar estoque de materiais de apoio (catálogos, brindes, amostras).
  • Acompanhar logística de entregas em conjunto com o setor responsável.
  • Garantir que os vendedores tenham materiais atualizados (catálogos, tabelas de preço).
  • Apoiar na organização do material que foi vendido.

    • Em resumo, o auxiliar de vendas não atua diretamente na negociação final, mas garante que os vendedores tenham informações, suporte e organização para focar nas vendas.

title: Analista de crédito
description:
Descrição da Empresa A Rayo Capital nasceu para ser a ponte entre incorporadoras e o capital necessário para transformar projetos em realidade. Atuamos como uma consultoria especializada no mercado imobiliário, oferecendo soluções financeiras estratégicas e adaptadas à realidade do setor. Nosso foco é impulsionar o desenvolvimento urbano e gerar oportunidades de investimento seguras e lucrativas para nossos parceiros.

Este é um cargo em regime de tempo integral, com modelo de trabalho híbrido em São Paulo, SP, permitindo alguns dias de trabalho remoto.


Qualificações

  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de analisar dados financeiros e identificar tendências para avaliar riscos e fundamentar recomendações estratégicas.
  • Comunicação: Habilidades de comunicação clara e objetiva para colaborar com outras partes da equipe e clientes, facilitando uma tomada de decisão eficaz.

title: Gerente de Serviços de Aplicações SAP
description:
Resumo da vaga

Estamos em busca de um Application Service Manager (SAP) experiente para atuar na gestão de aplicações corporativas, garantindo a estabilidade, desempenho e governança dos sistemas em um ambiente complexo e global.

O profissional será responsável por supervisionar o ciclo de vida das aplicações, gestão de fornecedores, controle de custos operacionais (OPEX) e conformidade com políticas de segurança e governança de TI.

Esta função exige forte capacidade de coordenação entre times técnicos e de negócio, experiência com ambiente SAP e tecnologias corporativas, além de habilidade para atuar em ambientes altamente regulados e orientados por SLAs.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gestão de aplicações:

Gerenciar o ciclo de vida das aplicações, incluindo monitoramento, tratamento de incidentes, manutenção e descontinuação de sistemas.

  • Governança e desempenho:

Definir e acompanhar KPIs e SLAs, garantindo a continuidade do negócio e a excelência na entrega de serviços.

  • Segurança e conformidade:

Assegurar que as aplicações estejam em conformidade com políticas de segurança da informação, proteção de dados e auditorias internas/externas.

  • Gestão de fornecedores:

Atuar como ponto focal na relação com fornecedores e prestadores de serviço, monitorando SLAs contratuais e conduzindo renovações.

  • Gestão financeira (OPEX):

Controlar orçamento, custos operacionais, previsões financeiras e identificar oportunidades de otimização de custos.

  • Gestão de mudanças:

Supervisionar a implantação de releases, patches e atualizações, assegurando a execução correta dos processos de change management.

  • Colaboração técnica:

Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas de arquitetura, segurança, times DevOps e “Function Towers” para garantir prontidão operacional antes do go-live.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência em TI: Mínimo de 5 a 7 anos de experiência em Operações de TI ou Gestão de Aplicações em ambientes corporativos de grande porte.
  • Conhecimento em SAP: Vivência em ambientes com SAP (ECC ou S/4HANA) e entendimento de integrações entre módulos e sistemas.
  • Governança de serviços: Conhecimento sólido em ITIL, gestão de SLAs, KPIs e boas práticas de gestão de serviços de TI.
  • Gestão de fornecedores: Experiência com gestão de contratos, acompanhamento de performance e negociação de melhorias de serviço.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos: Familiaridade com Azure, Microsoft Power Platform, Dataverse, ferramentas de monitoramento (Datadog, Grafana) e sistemas de chamados (ex.: ServiceNow) será um diferencial.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado é essencial.
  • Perfil comportamental: Fortes habilidades de comunicação, organização, visão analítica e capacidade de trabalhar com múltiplos stakeholders.

title: Senior Lean Management-Warehouse Layout
description:
Location: GLP Guarulhos II - R. Concretex, 800 - Cumbica, Guarulhos - SP,


ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


ABOUT THE ROLE

Key Responsibilities

1.Warehouse Layout Planning: Design warehouse layouts for new facilities and redesign existing layouts for renovation projects. Optimize picking, packing and shipping areas to reduce travel time, improve ergonomics and maximize space utilization.

2.Material Flow Optimization: Analyze inbound, put-away, picking and outbound processes; optimize material flow and work areas to increase efficiency.

3.Time Studies: Conduct detailed time studies and work sampling to establish and maintain standard operating times.

4.Capacity & ROI Analysis: Develop cost–benefit and ROI models for layout changes, automation investments and process improvements.

5.New Project Support: Provide IE support for new warehouse start-ups, process changes and layout integrations.

6.Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with operations, safety, IT and automation teams to ensure smooth implementation of changes.


Requirements

1.Bachelor’s degree or above in Industrial Engineering, Logistics Engineering, Operations Management or related fields.

2.5+ years of experience in warehouse IE, layout design or process improvement.

3.Familiarity with IE tools such as time studies, motion studies and capacity balancing.

4.Proficient in AutoCAD/Visio for layout design and Excel/Power BI for data analysis and reporting.

5.Strong numerical analysis and ROI modeling skills.

6.Excellent cross-department communication and coordination skills.

7.Good command of spoken and written English.


CAREERS AT SHEIN


We Commit to Inclusion

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.


We Empower Talents with Diverse Careers

At SHEIN, we empower talent to excel with regular opportunities to elevate their career in their respective fields. As a dynamic business, we support internal mobility, diverse career pathways and recognition of success and contribution in a variety of meaningful ways.


We Engage with Global Cultures

SHEIN has over 20 offices worldwide , providing talent with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues around the world. Perspective sharing and leveraging cultural differences, is one of our core strenghts as we work on many exciting projects and draw insights from industry-leading experience.

description:

Responsabilidades (Focus on IB DP):


O(A) profissional será responsável por planejar e ministrar aulas de Matemática focadas no IB Diploma Programme (DP) , abrangendo os níveis Standard Level (SL) e Higher Level (HL) .


  • Desenvolver e aplicar o currículo do IB DP e Pré-IB (Y10), fomentando a aprendizagem baseada em investigação (inquiry-based learning ).

A Escola Internacional de Alphaville está empenhada em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens estudantes, e espera que todos os colaboradores e voluntários partilhem deste compromisso.

A Escola Internacional de Alphaville está empenhada em fortalecer a nossa cultura inclusiva, identificando, contratando, desenvolvendo e retendo colegas de equipe de alto desempenho, independentemente do gênero, raça, orientação sexual, expressão de gênero, idade, deficiência, neuro divergência, origem socioeconômica e/ou outras características demográficas. As pessoas candidatas que compartilham com a nossa visão e princípios, e estão interessados em contribuir para o sucesso da escola através desta função são fortemente encorajadas a candidatar-se à vaga.

title: Business Development Manager, Mining Segment
description:
Position Overview

We seek a dynamic and results-driven Business Development Sales Manager to lead sales operations and business expansion in Brazil Region. This role is critical in driving market share growth within the mining sector, focusing on large OTR (Off-The-Road) tire solutions for heavy mining equipment. The ideal candidate must possess extensive mining industry networks, a hunter mentality for new business acquisition, and proven experience managing key accounts in demanding environments.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Business Development

  • Identify, target, and secure new clients in the mining industry across Brazil
  • Develop and execute growth strategies to achieve annual sales targets and market penetration goals.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with key decision-makers at mining corporations.

Key Account Management

  • Serve as the primary contact for Tier-1 mining clients.
  • Conduct quarterly business reviews to ensure client satisfaction and identify upsell opportunities.
  • Resolve complex client issues through technical expertise and resource coordination.

Market Intelligence & Expansion

  • Analyze competitor activities and market trends to refine pricing, product positioning, and value propositions.
  • Explore growth opportunities in adjacent sectors (quarrying, construction, ports).

Sales Operations Leadership

  • Manage the networks and field sales teams to ensure alignment with corporate objectives.
  • Monitor KPIs (revenue growth, profit margins, market share) and report biweekly to regional leadership.

Field Engagement

  • Spend ≥70% of time traveling to mining sites for technical consultations, audits, and contract negotiations.
  • Lead on-site troubleshooting for tire performance and safety challenges.


Qualifications & Requirements

Mandatory

  • Work Authorization: Valid right to work in Indonesia
  • Industry Expertise:
  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience in mining sectors.
  • Established network with mining operations, procurement heads, and fleet managers.
  • Sales Competency:
  • Demonstrated record of achieving >20% YoY growth in complex sales environments.
  • Expertise in large account development (>ZAR 50M contracts).
  • Personal Attributes:
  • Resilient, self-motivated, and able to thrive in high-pressure settings.
  • Physically fit to navigate remote mining sites and endure extended travel (up to 4 weeks/month).
  • Language: Native or fluent English proficiency (written and verbal)
  • Technical knowledge of OTR tires or heavy machinery.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary + uncapped commission
  • Travel allowance, fuel card,
  • Performance bonuses and career advancement opportunities.
  • Global career opportunity

O que você pensa quando alguém diz que existe uma excelente oportunidade de trabalho em um banco?


Um lugar onde as pessoas são secas? Um local onde só existe pressão e mais pressão?

Em alguns lugares pode até ser, mas aqui, no Banco Daycoval, existe um clima diferente!


O Daycoval é uma instituição financeira com mais de 50 anos, especializada em crédito para empresas, para pessoa física (consignado e financiamento de veículos), produtos de câmbio (comércio exterior e remessa), gestão de recursos e investimentos.


Nosso DNA sempre rendeu à companhia grandes reconhecimentos e prêmios, como o de Melhor Banco de Middle Market do Brasil por dois anos, conforme os resultados medidos pela Austin Rating e pelo jornal O Estado de S.Paulo.


Esse reconhecimento, vai muito além de um “prêmio”. Para nós, ele demonstra o compromisso de toda a companhia em fazer, dia a dia, um lugar melhor para se trabalhar. E quando pensamos em um lugar melhor, não falamos apenas em benefícios e salários. Falamos em engajamento, em projetos diferenciados e muito mais!


Musicantes: leva aulas de música e canto gratuitamente para colaboradores;

Programa de Qualidade de Vida: oferece, gratuitamente, projetos e eventos voltados à saúde e qualidade de vida, como a participação em corridas de rua, musicais, peças teatrais e exposições em museus.


E essa é só uma pequena parte do que temos por aqui!


Também temos uma importante missão com a sociedade! Por isso, promovemos campanhas solidárias e apoio direto, via doação ou lei de incentivo fiscal, para diversas instituições de renome.

Tudo isso torna possível a união entre a busca por resultados e o engajamento dos colaboradores com a sustentabilidade.


E não poderíamos deixar de falar que nós, do Daycoval, consideramos todos os talentos, independentemente de etnia, religião, cor, sexo, idade, condição de deficiência, nacionalidade, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, ou qualquer outro motivo que caracterize discriminação pela legislação local.

title: Pessoa Supervisora de Auditoria e Performance
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

description:

Industry Expertise:

  • Utilize your deep understanding of preconstruction processes, including takeoff/estimation, bid management, and qualification/risk management.

Prospective Sales Support:

  • Ability to conduct product demos for prospective customers along with industry knowledge to showcase TrueBuilt's preconstruction software and its value proposition.

  • Engage with customers, industry professionals, and stakeholders to understand their pain points, challenges, and needs.

  • Provide training, support, and guidance to customers in adopting and maximizing the use of TrueBuilt's software solutions.


Content Creation:

  • Contribute to thought leadership content, including blog posts, whitepapers, and industry presentations, to establish TrueBuilt as a trusted authority in preconstruction.
  • Represent TrueBuilt at industry events, conferences, and webinars to share insights and network with industry professionals.
  • Act as an ambassador for TrueBuilt, building relationships with industry influencers and fostering partnerships.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent industry experience).

If you are a passionate industry professional with a strong understanding of preconstruction workflows and the desire to shape the future of preconstruction software, we want to hear from you.   • Desejável experiência prévia em P&D, controle de qualidade ou indústria alimentícia;
  • Perfil proativo, curioso e colaborativo;
  • Desejável noções de informática (Excel, planilhas de testes, etc.).

title: Consultor de suporte técnico - tintas
description:
Descrição do Cargo:


  • É a referência técnica em sua região de atuação, aplicar treinamentos nas modalidades presencial teórico e prático ou virtual para públicos Pintor, Balconista e outros. Também realiza atendimento a chamados técnicos provenientes do SACC de forma remota ou presencial que envolvem suporte a reclamações, especificações técnicas, demonstrações ou outras intervenções onde existe necessidade da presença técnica da companhia.

Responsabilidades:


  • Gestão do fluxo completo do atendimento à reclamações sendo: Receber chamado através de sistema vigente, analisar o caso, contatar o consumidor, realizar prévia investigação, decidir necessidade de visita in loco ou não, realizar tratativas e coleta de evidências, realizar encerramento do chamado. Realizar fluxo em prazo determinado pelo SAC (até 20 dias) ideal até 14 dias.
  • Emissão de relatórios técnicos para chamados onde ocorrem divergência de opinião entre consumidor e empresa, além do envio para validação do coordenador da área.

  • Realiza treinamentos técnicos para Pintores, Balconistas, e demais públicos de interesse, com objetivo de apresentar melhores soluções da companhia, melhores práticas para aplicação de produtos, mitigar problemas técnicos, etc... sendo responsável pelo fluxo de captação, negociação, agendamento, execução serviços administrativos como pedido de reembolso, etc...
  • Realiza provisões de recursos para atividades de treinamento a ser realizada em sua região de atuação.
  • Realiza gestão de brindes e realiza distribuição dos mesmos de acordo com estratégia alinhada com coordenador.
  • Atua como apoio regional quando ocorre necessidade de execução de grandes eventos para pintores ou outros públicos, executas sob orientação do coordenador.


Conhecimentos:


  • Nível Médio completo - Mandatório
  • Nível Técnico em Edificações, Design de interiores, Química (é um diferencial)
  • Nível Superior em Negócios, Marketing, Química, Engenharia (Desejável)
  • Conhecimento técnico intermediário (Mínimo 4 anos trabalhando no segmentos de tintas em área técnicas ou de contato direto com produtos em marketing ou vendas).
  • Conhecimento em manipulação de tintas e aplicações em área médias (Demonstração)
  • Conhecimento intermediário sistemas tintométrico.
  • Conhecimentos em informática essencial (Power Point, Excel, Internet)
  • Redação e interpretação de textos.


Habilidades:

  • Comunicação e colaboração com outras equipes.
  • Oratória dinâmica para transmissão de ideias e interação com público.


Comportamentos:

  • Proatividade, agilidade e senso de urgência com foco em resultados.

Localidade:

title: Analista de Controles Internos
description:
Na Hyundai Motor Brasil, buscamos profissionais apaixonados pela excelência e comprometidos em obter os melhores resultados sempre. Como Analista Pleno de Controles Internos, você será parte do time responsável por assegurar a eficácia dos processos e dos controles internos da organização.


As principais atividades serão:


  • Suportar as Áreas de Negócios na elaboração de Políticas, Procedimentos e demais documentos da HMCSA;
  • Revisar Políticas e Procedimentos garantindo que os documentos sejam elaborados em conformidade com as diretrizes internas e externas (SOX, COSO).
  • Conduzir avaliações de riscos dos processos da HMCSA, baseando-se em probabilidade e impacto, bem como propor melhorias e ações corretivas para mitigar riscos identificados;
  • Realizar testes de eficácia dos controles internos, documentando resultados e sugerindo melhorias;
  • Conduzir treinamentos para colaboradores sobre a importância dos controles internos, utilização de controles e ferramentas e demais assuntos relacionados a promoção da cultura de controles internos na organização;
  • Dar suporte as Áreas de Negócios nos planos de ações corretivos decorrentes dos processos de Auditoria Interna, Prevenção a Fraudes, Due Diligence e Investigação Interna, propondo cenários de melhoria e conduzindo a Área de Negócios para o saneamento do ponto;
  • Conduzir projetos relacionados a Controles Internos, realizando reuniões com as áreas envolvidas.
  • Monitorar e manter atualizada a matriz de risco, garantindo a identificação contínua de novos riscos e a eficácia das estratégias de mitigação implementadas.
  • Mapear processos documentando e analisando fluxos de trabalho, identificando gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Participação em projetos de controles internos, acompanhando projetos da empresa como um todo para identificar riscos desde o início e garantir a implementação de medidas preventivas.


Se interessou? Os requisitos para concorrer à vaga são:


  • Ensino Superior completo;
  • Experiência prévia em controles internos, auditoria ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias como SOX e COSO;
  • Domínio pacote Office;
  • Inglês Avançado.


Desejável:


  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de mapeamento de processos, como: fluxograma, 5W2Hs, Visio, entre outros.



Local de trabalho: Piracicaba, SP - Modelo híbrido.



A Hyundai Motor Company, sediada na Coreia do Sul, está passando por uma transição significativa de ser fabricante de automóveis para se tornar provedora de soluções de mobilidade inteligente. Para acelerar a concretização dessa mudança, estamos investindo em tecnologias inovadoras que transformarão a maneira como as pessoas interagem com suas soluções de mobilidade e melhorarão sua qualidade de vida.


Comprometida com a sustentabilidade, a Hyundai iniciou medidas para liderar uma era de mobilidade mais sustentável eletrificando sua linha de produtos e expandindo seus negócios de hidrogênio para veículos comerciais e dispositivos de utilidade. Além da mobilidade, confiaremos na economia circular para moldar um futuro mais sustentável que beneficiará não apenas a Hyundai como empresa, mas a sociedade como um todo.


A Hyundai Motor Brasil começou suas operações em 2012, introduzindo o modelo único HB20 no mercado local, projetado e desenvolvido especificamente para o país. Atualmente, a empresa atua como sede regional para a América Central e do Sul, exportando do Brasil para Uruguai, Paraguai, Colômbia e México. Com perspectivas promissoras para a região, a Hyundai Motor Brasil, também conhecida como Hyundai Motor Central & South América, está introduzindo tecnologia de ponta de modelos premiados mundialmente, como o IONIQ 5, e avançando para implementar soluções movidas a hidrogênio junto com ações sociais e ambientais para contribuir com as sociedades onde opera na região. Se você aspira fazer parte de uma equipe líder em inovação na indústria automotiva, venha se juntar a nós na Hyundai e faça parte desta jornada rumo ao sucesso.


Movimento audacioso, energia positiva e trabalho de qualidade; este é o nosso DNA Hyundai; este foi o poder que nos permitiu ser líder global na indústria automotiva e será o poder para criar um novo mundo. Estamos em busca de talentos que escreverão uma nova página de nossa história com o DNA Hyundai.


Venha crescer conosco!!!

Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!


Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.


Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)


Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.
